dogecoin.text: #dogecoin y’all learn your lesson. Welcome to crypto little ones

@itsALLrisky @elonmusk Better than Bitcoin isn’t saying much. There are still much better options than dogecoin. Dogecoin takes 40 minutes per transaction. Xrp takes 3-7 seconds. Average transaction cost 2+ dollars. Xrp transaction cost less than 2 cents. Sorry but doge is not the future
